title: Nutrition (full) — the image and the measured build
question: Built through impeccable's measured pipeline: the tubes are the image's own glass, sizes measured off the comp, and the build scored against it at 74% (pass mark 72%). Not on dev yet. Approve for dev, or say what is still off.

options.label: Approved image
options.thesis: The full nutrition screen in frosted glass.

options.label: Build, English
options.thesis: Phone-sized capture (376pt, 2x), same sample day as the image.
options.viewport: Header, tubes, what is left, water, meals, tab bar.
options.risk: Deliberate: 'kcal left' keeps its unit instead of 'left today'; meal rows keep their macros and delete button.

options.label: Build, Hebrew
options.thesis: The same screen right to left; number pairs stay left to right.

options.label: Measured side by side
options.thesis: Impeccable's own comparison: image left, build right, with the scores underneath.
options.viewport: Structure, colour, detail and band scores at the foot.
options.risk: Small remaining gaps: the fat tube's scale height, the + button, the water quick-adds carry 'ml'.
